exposure: Participation in Best Fed Beginnings (BFB) quality improvement collaborative
outcome: Mother's milk feeding (MMF) at hospital discharge
cohort: The study included 1,077 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants born between January 2006 and June 2016 at a single institution.
finding: Participation in the Best Fed Beginnings collaborative was associated with an increase in mother's milk feeding (MMF) at discharge and a decrease in the median time to pump initiation in mothers of VLBW infants.
